problem: Allen-Cahn 1-D periodic, eps 2.5e-4, n 1024, tanh of random modes 1-6 (seed 7), T 1

construction.rule: u0 = tanh(4 f / max|f|), f = sum_k a_k cos(2 pi k x) + b_k sin(2 pi k x), x = j/N

environment.timer: time.perf_counter around each solve; median of the repeats reported, all repeats archived
